question.text: Ganga Credit Opportunities Fund receives an ODD (Operational DD) request covering 'business operations and internal controls'. The ODD specialist wants to verify basic control hygiene. Per Ch 12, which is a MUST-HAVE baseline control?

answer.text: Maker-checker control and access controls on confidential client data.
A dedicated Chief Artificial Intelligence Officer on staff.
ISO 27001 certification of the sponsor's parent company.
SEBI-issued ISIN for every investor class.

explanation.text: The Logic: Ch 12 states 'basic controls, such as maker-checker control and access controls when handling confidential data' are preconditions for operating in financial markets. The Trap: B, C, D are not baseline. ISO 27001 is desirable but not a Ch 12 minimum; SEBI issues AIF registration, not ISINs for investor classes. Cross-Exam Context: Maker-checker echoes III-A/C (Compliance) and XXIV (AML). In XIX-C, absence of maker-checker is an instant ODD red flag for institutional LPs.
